# Chorus

> Chorus is an agent-native FastAPI and MCP service that turns podcast transcripts into persona-conditioned, timestamp-grounded highlights and a short audio episode.

Agents should start with the README build instructions, then use the skill for
the complete request and response contract. The service accepts either a master
bearer token or a self-serve API key delivered by email.

## Agent entrypoints

- [Build instructions](https://github.com/ctmmit/chorus/blob/main/README.md): Install the skill or MCP server, interview the principal, and submit the first digest.
- [Chorus skill](https://github.com/ctmmit/chorus/blob/main/SKILL.md): Complete HTTP contract, limits, lifecycle, and error semantics.
- [Soul interview skill](https://github.com/ctmmit/chorus/blob/main/skills/chorus-soul-bootstrap/SKILL.md): Questions and exact soul.md schema.
- [Weekly digest skill](https://github.com/ctmmit/chorus/blob/main/skills/chorus-weekly/SKILL.md): Recurring gather, context refresh, polling, and delivery workflow.

## Developer documentation

- [Deployment](https://github.com/ctmmit/chorus/blob/main/DEPLOY.md): Environment and hosting setup.
- [Development plan](https://github.com/ctmmit/chorus/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md): Architecture decisions and phased roadmap.
- [Agent conventions](https://github.com/ctmmit/chorus/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository map, verification gates, and implementation rules.

## Optional

- OpenAPI: `GET /openapi.json` on any deployed Chorus instance (bearer token required) returns the machine-readable HTTP schemas.
